label: Grafana
agentGuide: Dashboards: GET /api/search?query=<words>&type=dash-db (uid, title, url); one: GET /api/dashboards/uid/<uid> (dashboard.panels with their queries). Data sources: GET /api/datasources; query one: POST /api/ds/query {"queries": [{"refId": "A", "datasource": {"uid": "..."}, "expr": "up"}], "from": "now-1h", "to": "now"}. Alerts: GET /api/alertmanager/grafana/api/v2/alerts (firing ones), rules: GET /api/v1/provisioning/alert-rules; annotations: GET /api/annotations?from=&to=, add: POST /api/annotations {"text": "...", "tags": [..]}. Health: GET /api/health; org: GET /api/org; users: GET /api/org/users. Saving a dashboard replaces it: read it first and keep its version.
